描述_EN: the ground is sparsely scattered with clouds, bats and flowers (such as tree peonies and plum blossoms). the top border has three red roundels on a gold ground. panel or wall hanging of red tapestry weave (kesi) silk. the panel is in a horseshoe shape with an overlapping top border. four other four-clawed dragons in profile are disposed around while another issues from the waves at the base of either side of the horseshoe. the top border is edged with the same meander pattern as the lower panel. there is a narrow border surrounding the whole panel with a meander pattern in gold on blue. the roundels contain scenes depicting 'filial piety' stories. in the centre of the panel is a fronted four-clawed dragon with a jewel. between the roundels are the symbols of the eight taoist immortals. above this top border is a blue cotton strip 4 inches deep.
描述_ZN: 地面稀疏地散布着云朵、蝙蝠和花朵（如树上的牡丹和梅花）。 顶部的边框有三个金底的红色圆环。 红色挂毯或壁挂，由红色挂毯编织而成。 面板呈马蹄形，上面有一个重叠的边框。 其他四条四爪龙的轮廓分布在周围，而另一条龙则从马蹄形两侧底部的波浪中发出。 上面的边框与下面的面板一样有蜿蜒的图案。 有一个狭窄的边框围绕整个面板，有一个蓝底金字的蜿蜒图案。 圆环上有描绘 "孝道 "故事的场景。 在面板的中心是一条带着宝石的四爪龙的正面。 在圆环之间是道教八仙的标志。 在这个顶层边框上面是一个4英寸深的蓝色棉条。
